## [1.3.1-dev.2](https://github.com/SapitoSucio/FroggoMorphePatches/compare/v1.3.1-dev.1...v1.3.1-dev.2) (2026-09-03)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* **release:** restore automatic dev pull requests ([059a747](https://github.com/SapitoSucio/FroggoMorphePatches/commit/059a7471ca5065e75cc88814b45dc8d38ed6132e))

patches.name: Block Facebook automatic refresh (573)
patches.description: Experimental: blocks automatic foreground/hot-start/stale-tab/stale-post feed refresh while preserving cold initialization, manual, activity-result and fullscreen refresh paths.

patches.name: Block Facebook Feed ads (573)
patches.description: Blocks sponsored and promoted units in the Facebook 573 Feed without touching Reels or Stories.

patches.name: Block Facebook Reels ads (573)
patches.description: Blocks sponsored Reels in the swipe feed plus Reels/video banners, video ads, and commercial breaks.

patches.name: Block Facebook Story ads (573)
patches.description: Filters Story ad buckets only at the concrete X68 provider return boundary.

patches.name: Change Facebook app theme (573)
patches.description: Adds AMOLED Black and Material You palettes while preserving Facebook's light/dark mode selection.

options.description: AMOLED Black changes only Facebook's dark palette. Material You follows the system dynamic palette in both light and dark mode.

patches.name: Download Facebook Media (573)
patches.description: Adds direct downloads for the visible Story, Reel, and video media through MediaStore.

options.description: Relative MediaStore folder prefix. The creator name is appended after @.
Folder below Movies. The creator name is appended after @.

patches.name: Facebook 573 AI content diagnostics
patches.description: Logs Facebook GenAI structural flags for Feed stories without filtering them.

patches.name: Facebook 573 AI filter + recommendation diagnostics
patches.description: Filters detected AI Feed stories and logs structural metadata for DiscoverFeedUnit recommendation candidates in one bytecode injection.

patches.name: Facebook 573 Feed recommendation diagnostics
patches.description: Logs structural metadata for injected Feed stories without filtering them.

patches.name: Hide Facebook AI content (573)
patches.description: Filters Feed posts carrying Facebook's GenAI transparency metadata (Contenido de IA).

patches.name: Stop Facebook Story auto-advance (573)
patches.description: Leaves photo and video Stories on their completed frame until the viewer navigates manually.

options.description: When enabled, each completed Story restarts instead of advancing to the next Story.
